description: TypeScript SDK and MCP server for the Marzban panel API — typed endpoints, auth, retries, WebSocket log streaming, and webhooks.
rules: Construct the SDK with createMarzbanSDK(config), not `new MarzbanSDK(config)` directly.
marzban-mcp is a separate package built entirely on marzban-sdk — it has no HTTP logic of its own.
Narrow SDK errors with the exported type guards (isHttpError, isAuthError, isConfigurationError, isWebhookError), not by matching error.code strings.
